title: Reports
description: Revenue, exceptions, shifts, stock, visits and the lab, with Excel export and printing.

revenue.title: Daily revenue
revenue.description: By department, doctor and payment method. Pending transfers are kept apart and never counted as collected.

shift_variances.title: Shift variances
shift_variances.description: Closed shifts with expected, counted and the difference, by cashier and date.

pending_transfers.title: Pending transfers
pending_transfers.description: Transfers waiting for verification, by age in days, and payer cheques not yet cleared.

adjustments.title: Discounts, cancellations, refunds
adjustments.description: Who approved what and why: discounts, credit notes, lines cancelled before billing and refunds.

payer_receivables.title: Payer receivables
payer_receivables.description: What payers owe by claim stage and by age. A payer share is never cash until paid.

requested_not_invoiced.title: Requested, not invoiced
requested_not_invoiced.description: Orders that never reached the cashier, oldest first, with their age.

paid_not_performed.title: Paid, not performed
paid_not_performed.description: Paid services still waiting to be done, with the amount at stake.

performed_by_authorization.title: Performed by authorization
performed_by_authorization.description: Services done before payment, with who allowed them and why.

stock_valuation.title: Stock valuation
stock_valuation.description: Stock on hand at batch cost, by item and store, with expired stock.

stock_movement.title: Stock movement
stock_movement.description: Opening, received, dispensed, adjusted and closing quantities per item.

stock_variance.title: Stock count variance
stock_variance.description: Book against counted stock of the posted counts, with the value of the difference.

stock_expiry.title: Stock expiry
stock_expiry.description: Batches expiring soon or already expired, with quantity and value.

visits.title: Patient visits
visits.description: Visits by day, department and doctor, new against follow-up.

lab_turnaround.title: Lab turnaround and volume
lab_turnaround.description: Minutes from sample to approved result per test, and tests ordered and done.

empty.title: No reports for your role
empty.description: Ask the administrator for access to the reports you need.

viewer.truncated: Only the first {{rows}} rows are shown. Narrow the period or the filters to see the rest.
viewer.emptyDescription: Nothing matches these filters. Try other dates or a different department.
viewer.unknownDescription: This report does not exist. Choose one from the list.
